newsitem.title: USA: Chemical Financial buys insurance company.
newsitem.headline: Chemical Financial buys insurance company.

text.p: CFC Financial Services Inc, a unit of Chemical Financial Corp said Tuesday it purchased Arbury & Stephenson Inc, a full-line insurance agency.
No financial terms were disclosed. CFC is the insurance subsidiary of Chemical Bank and Trust Co, a wholly owned subsidiary of Chemical Financial.

CFC will retain the name of Arbury & Stephenson and continue to operate the property and casualty insurance agency, founded in 1957, in Midland. Existing workers will continue to be employed by CFC. The firm's offices will eventually move to the Chemical Bank and & Trust headquarters in Midland.
